decisions.reason: As a generic address autocomplete not central to regulated energy processes, its uncertain value and low differentiation make it likely to be abandoned to free resources.
The Austrian gas grid fee database is domain-specific market data with continuing regulatory demand, so its option value remains high and costs are justified.
Peak load window determination is a high-value analytical service for network operators, clearly aligned with the firm's core expertise.
The end-customer tariff database provides recurring data needed by suppliers, making its value relatively certain and worth keeping.
Custom web services remain a flexible option that supports consulting and can lead to new platform modules, so keeping it open is low cost.
Postal code lookup is a generic commodity with limited differentiation and likely low value realization, so abandoning it releases resources.
